summary: Middle-earth game entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Middle-earth: Shadow of Mordor
entries.definitive_edition: PC Game of the Year Edition at final offline state

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC GOTY build at high settings

primary.version: Game of the Year Edition / final offline state
primary.why: The PC Game of the Year route includes the major story/skin/challenge DLC and gives the best capture/settings ceiling. Online-linked Vendetta/leaderboard-style features have been retired or changed, so preserve the final offline state.
primary.how_to_play: Use the PC Game of the Year Edition with all DLC installed. Record storefront/build, DLC list, graphics settings, Nemesis-system state, difficulty, and any removed/retired online features.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record DLC and retired online-feature state.

entries.title: Middle-earth: Shadow of War
entries.definitive_edition: PC Definitive Edition / final post-marketplace state

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC Definitive Edition at documented settings

primary.why: The PC Definitive Edition route includes the major expansions and has the best capture/settings ceiling. The 2018 removal of the real-money marketplace and later balance/endgame changes mean the current definitive route is not identical to launch.
primary.how_to_play: Use the PC Definitive Edition with all expansion content installed. Record storefront/build, DLC list, difficulty, graphics settings, Nemesis system state, online vendetta/conquest availability, and whether launch-era marketplace changes are being discussed.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only for console performance or controls comparison.
secondary.why: PC Definitive Edition is the best capture and completeness route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record DLC and post-marketplace state explicitly.
